newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Blue Cross expulsion upheld by appeals court.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Blue Cross expulsion upheld by appeals court.

text.p: A U.S. appeals court has upheld a decision by the national Blue Cross & Blue Shield Association to expel its Ohio affiliate, the unit said on Wednesday.
The unit, called Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Ohio, said it was "surprised and disappointed" with the court's decision.
Blue Cross of Ohio said it planned to appeal the decision by the Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals. The unit said the court's decision would have no effect on services to its customers.
"It is still my hope that we will be able to resolve our differences outside of court," Kent Clapp, acting chairman, president and chief operating officer of Blue Cross of Ohio, said in a statement.
Earlier this month, the state of Ohio said it would reject Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp's proposed $299.5 million acquisition of most of Ohio Blue Cross.
